name: Fixed-Term Employment
text: This is a contract of fixed-term employment. (a) The Employee is engaged for a fixed term commencing on the date of joining and expiring automatically on the end date specified in this Agreement, unless renewed in writing or terminated earlier in accordance with this Agreement. (b) During the fixed term, the Employee shall be entitled to hours of work, wages, allowances and other benefits that are not less than those available to a permanent workman doing the same or similar work, in accordance with the Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Central (Amendment) Rules, 2018 and the Industrial Relations Code, 2020. (c) The Employee engaged on a fixed-term basis shall be eligible for gratuity if the Employee renders service under the contract for the period specified, on a pro-rata basis, notwithstanding that the period of continuous service is less than five (5) years. (d) Expiry of the fixed term by efflux of time shall not constitute retrenchment, and no notice of non-renewal or retrenchment compensation shall be payable solely by reason of such expiry, provided the term is not extended. (e) Nothing in this clause shall be construed to convert the fixed-term engagement into permanent employment by mere continuation beyond the stated term without an express written agreement.

invalid_if: Fixed-term worker denied wages/benefits at parity with permanent workmen doing similar work
